name: ♀ na Ore de Love x3
source:
Tsukasa is a boy possessed by his twin sister who ended up passing on. 
He transfers to the high school she attended to tie up any instances of unfulfilled love.
At first, Tsukasa only thinks he's letting his sister rest in peace...

This is the first chapter of this naughty possesion, gender swapping, girls clothes wearing adventure game!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050012.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
茨卡萨是一名被已故双胞胎姐妹附身的男孩。
他转入姐妹生前就读的高中，想为那些未能圆满的恋情画上句号。
起初，茨卡萨只以为，自己是在让姐妹安息…

这是这部调皮的附身、性别互换与女装冒险游戏的第一章！
